explanation:
CODE AUDIT OF PINNED v5 (blq-composed-core-scc-emra-ialh5-v5):
Auditing run_counting, run_counting_core, compression.py, core_refutation.py, check_scc_and_growth.py, test_elim.py, and test_mra.py reveals no soundness bug producing a wrong SAT answer:
1. compression.py: _verify_certificate groups every original clause into exact-support blocks, checks no duplicate/tautological literals, checks every referenced quotient form is supported inside that block's mask, exhaustively verifies evaluate(clauses, x) == evaluate(q, image) over points(support), and checks P * L = I_r entrywise over GF(2). By conjunction over blocks and linearity of P, this certifies exact equisatisfiability of original and quotient.
2. core_refutation.py: Independently enforces set(core).issubset(set(f)), requires compress_root(core) to succeed, restricts acceptance to binary quotients (all len(c) <= 2), and uses exact implication-graph 2-SAT (two_sat). In run_counting, applying probe once to an exact compressed quotient is sound by equisatisfiability. SAT/UNKNOWN always falls back.
3. Residual solver: canon (tautology removal, UP, subsumption), signed_scc (2-CNF SCC contraction), elim (size-nonincreasing DP), prune (removing stronger disjuncts via below), and refute/verify_certificate (UP-filtered tables + Fraction-verified integer-lattice dual) are each sound.

GROWTH FIXTURE CONSTRUCTION (18 vars, 158 clauses -> exact 14-var, 64-clause quotient):
Because no soundness bug was found, we construct a larger compressed UNSAT fixture targeting both v5 residual growth and Fable73/Fable105's proposed nonlinear modular/twin-contraction (MSQ) repairs.
Start from a 14-variable, 64-clause module-free quotient Q:
- Left C_7 on odd variables in cycle order (1, 7, 3, 9, 5, 11, 13): 7 edges E_i. Its 7 maximal independent sets all have size 3; their 7 complements (minimal vertex covers of size 4) give 7 negative 4-clauses: [-7,-9,-11,-13], [-1,-3,-5,-13], [-1,-7,-9,-11], [-3,-5,-7,-13], [-1,-3,-9,-11], [-5,-7,-9,-13], [-1,-3,-5,-11]. Any assignment avoiding all-zero left edges has 0-set an independent set of C_7, so its 1-set contains one of these 7 minimal vertex covers, falsifying a negative clause. Thus at least one left edge E_i is (0,0).
- Right C_7 on even variables in cycle order (2, 8, 4, 10, 6, 12, 14): 7 edges F_j and the mirror 7 negative 4-clauses, forcing at least one right edge F_j to be (0,0).
- 49 positive cross 4-clauses E_i U F_j (for all i, j in 0..6), forbidding any pair (E_i, F_j) from both being (0,0). Thus Q is UNSAT (63 clauses already UNSAT).
- One extra cross-side negative 4-clause C* = [-1,-2,-3,-4] on non-adjacent left vertices {1,3} and non-adjacent right vertices {2,4}.

Exact BLQ expansion to 18 variables, 158 clauses:
Replace four non-adjacent quotient variables not in C* by weight-2 XOR forms: q_9 = x_9 ^ x_15, q_10 = x_10 ^ x_16, q_11 = x_11 ^ x_17, q_12 = x_12 ^ x_18. Each positive literal +q expands to [(x,y), (-x,-y)] and each negative literal -q expands to [(-x,y), (x,-y)], expanding the 64 quotient blocks to 158 original clauses of width 4..6 (18 left neg + 18 right neg + 121 cross pos + 1 C*).

WHY IT PASSES COMPRESSION, SURVIVES COMPOSED CORE, AND GROWS ON v5:
1. Exact compression (not a skip): Each of the 64 blocks has 1, 2, or 4 forbidden points with exact stabilizer generated by the expanded pairs in that block. In compress_root's greedy sort (-freq, weight, mask), singletons x_1..x_4 have frequency 19 (weight 1), singletons x_5..x_8, x_13, x_14 have frequency 18 (weight 1), and the 4 XOR forms have frequency 18 (weight 2), while all unintended linear combinations have frequency <= 8. Thus compress_root deterministically selects the exact 14-form basis, placing x_1, x_2, x_3, x_4 first in the quotient's ascending branching order, and passes verify_certificate (2528 local points << 16384).
2. Composed core UNKNOWN: On the original input, every block's forbidden set is already a complete coset of its stabilizer (counts equal |z|), so probe removes 0 clauses (no_clauses_removed). On the quotient, every block has |z| = 1, so probe again returns no_clauses_removed.
3. Residual growth (predicted peak 7 on v5, fast runtime): At the quotient root, all 64 clauses have width 4, so canon_plus is idle, elim_plus is stuck (each var has 14 pos x 4 neg = 56 resolvents vs 18 clauses), and IALH-5 finds 0 constraints. In ascending quotient order (1, 2, 3, ...), branching on 1 (left u_0), 2 (right v_0), 3 (left u_2) yields 2 states at layer 1, 4 states at layer 2, and 7 retained states at layer 3 (only (1=1,3=1,2=0) is refuted by UP-triggered IALH-5 via left binary negative clauses forcing an all-zero edge). Layer 4 drops to few states and layer 5 terminates UNSAT in ~33 IALH calls (fast, avoiding timeouts). Note: this is a finite growth witness, not an asymptotic lower bound.

COUNTEREXAMPLE TO FABLE73 LINK-TWIN CONTRACTION AND FABLE105 MSQ:
Unlike Neon58's disjoint OR-twin pairs, Q has no nontrivial syntactic modules T (2 <= |T| <= 13). Every left/right variable belongs to two overlapping C_7 edges, so no proper subset of a side has context CNFs equivalent to a single function f, not-f, or false (eliminating all bounded-arity modules). Moreover, C* = [-1,-2,-3,-4] gives context {-2,-4} on the full left side L seeing (-1 v -3), which is inequivalent to g(L), not-g(L), or false, breaking even the global 7-variable modules L and R. Nearby SAT control: deleting any single cross clause E_i U F_j makes the 64-clause quotient SAT (set E_i = F_j = (0,0) and all other variables to 1, except if {1,2,3,4} are all 1, pick an edge containing one of {1,3} or {2,4}).
mechanism_signature: Exact BLQ-expanded module-free C_7 x C_7 vertex-cover/edge transversal contradiction with cross-side module-breaking clause [-1,-2,-3,-4]; compresses 18v/158c -> 14v/64c, core UNKNOWN at both stages, eliminates all syntactic modules of sizes 2..13, predicted v5 peak 7.
